translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

content: A ninge utano hinahaan uram Ierusalem. Devit ga pit ie.

content.text: Iau ga guama ing di ga tange tagu bia,
“Dahat gi haan ukatiga tano hala na lotu tano Watong.”
Ira kaki dahat i tur taar um
narako tano matanangaas laka ta Ierusalem.
Di ga gil Ierusalem hoing tiga tamat na pise na hala
ing ira uno hala diet tur hutet tika.
Ira huntunaan diet la haan hanut ukaia,
diet at ira huntunaan tano Watong,
wara pirpirlat no hinsana no Watong
haruat ma no harkurai nong gate tar ta Israel.
Kaia ira kinkinis wara gil harkurai i la tur taar,
kaike ira kinkinis na harkurai at tano huntunaan ta Devit.
Sasaring utano malum ta Ierusalem hoken:
“Sige ing diet kalak ugu, iau sip bia diet na lon timaan.
Na tahut bia na mon malum narako ta ira num balo
ma ra harbalaurai timaan mah.”
Iau ni tange tiga nianga ta Ierusalem wara gaiena ira tasigu ma ira nugu harwis,
ma i hoken, “A malum na kis taam.”
Iau ni silihe ira bilbilai ta Ierusalem
wara gaiena no hala na lotu tano Watong, no udahat God.
